capabilities: Mark headings as read, written, or missing/extra via clickable buttons
Cascade parent statuses from subheadings automatically
Jump to the next unread or flagged heading
Show per-note progress statistics and a desktop status bar
Store status in heading comments while preserving formatting
extras: Works entirely offline with no network requests, telemetry, accounts, or payment; progress syncs via the user's existing sync service. Version 1.1.1 fixes a startup crash on fresh installations from 1.1.0.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to mark study completion per heading or see progress through a note's topics.
summary: Study-progress tracker that adds Read, Written, and Missing/Extra status buttons, statistics, and navigation to Markdown headings.
